import csv
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, time
def get_mean_occupancy(csv_path, ts_id):
    with open(csv_path, newline='') as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        df = pd.DataFrame(reader)
        df = df[df['timeseries_id'] == ts_id]
        df['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df['timestamp'])
        mask = (df['timestamp'].dt.date == datetime(2018, 10, 3).date()) & (df['timestamp'].dt.time >= time(8)) & (df['timestamp'].dt.time <= time(18))
        hourly_values = df.loc[mask, 'value'].astype(float)
        mean_occupancy = hourly_values.mean()
        return mean_occupancy
